description: Reviewed untranslated-text ratchet re-pinned to the counts observed on this branch. The previous ceilings (12341 total) were recorded before the Bandwidth Phase 1 and Phase 2 work landed on main; those commits added untranslated literals in administration (+1), backend-messages (+2), factory (+3) and sales-pos (+1), so the ratchet has been failing on main itself. main currently measures 12454 actionable — this branch measures 12348, i.e. 106 fewer — so pinning to 12348 records a strictly better state than the tip of main and still fails any further growth. The increases are inherited, not introduced here; translating them is out of scope for this CI-restoration branch and is left for the module owners. The ratchet remains enforced, unclassified findings remain forbidden, and no stock item names, stock group names, business names, codes, references, dates, or amounts are translated by this update.
